questions.question: I ______ on the educational website for two hours, and I have already found five useful research articles.
questions.explanation: The Present Perfect Continuous tense ('have been searching') is used for an action that started in the past and continues up to or affects the present, especially when specified by a duration like 'for two hours'.

questions.question: The invention of the internet has been a great boon to global communication. What is the closest contextual meaning of 'boon'?
questions.explanation: In reading passages on technology, a 'boon' refers to a helpful benefit, blessing, or advantage.

questions.question: The school administration decided to do ______ paper-based assignment submissions and switch to digital uploads.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'do away with' means to abolish, eliminate, or stop using something.

questions.question: While Solomon ______ an online lecture on computer programming, his internet connection suddenly dropped.
questions.explanation: An ongoing background action in the past interrupted by a sudden past event takes the Past Continuous tense ('was watching').

questions.question: According to the Unit 10 listening text, the internet has accelerated human interaction primarily through ______.

options.text: instant messaging, emails, and online forums

questions.explanation: Section 10.1 explains that internet technology accelerated global human interaction via instant messaging, email, and social media platforms.

questions.question: As computers become increasingly pervasive in modern society, people use them everywhere from buses to classrooms. What does 'pervasive' mean in this context?

options.text: Spreading widely throughout an area or group of people

questions.explanation: Contextually, 'pervasive' describes something that has spread widely and is present throughout all parts of a community or system.

questions.question: Exhausted after studying all night, the student unintentionally ______ in front of his laptop screen.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'doze off' means to fall asleep unintentionally for a short time.

questions.question: Aster ______ three online quizzes last week, but she ______ her final web project yet.
questions.explanation: Definite completed past time phrases like 'last week' take the Simple Past ('completed'), while the adverb 'yet' paired with an unfinished state takes the Present Perfect ('hasn't submitted').

questions.question: Digital word processors allow students to print assignments in neat and legible fonts. What is the contextual meaning of 'legible'?
questions.explanation: In typography and writing contexts, 'legible' means clear enough to be read easily.

questions.question: Complete the dialogue: Chala: 'In my opinion, spending more than four hours a day on social media reduces face-to-face communication skills.' Bontu: '______; students should balance their online time with real-life interactions.'
questions.explanation: 'I couldn't agree more' is a standard formal expression used to indicate strong agreement with an opinion.

questions.question: By the time the IT technician arrived at the school library, the network outage ______ for more than forty-five minutes.
questions.explanation: When an ongoing duration occurred before another completed past event ('arrived'), the Past Perfect Continuous tense ('had been lasting') is required.

questions.question: Before the software company launched its new application, the development team ______ on the program's security features for eight consecutive months.
questions.explanation: The Past Perfect Continuous tense ('had been working') expresses an action that was ongoing for a specified duration prior to a defined past event ('launched').

questions.question: The passage states: 'It depends on our wisely making use of a computer to turn it into a boon instead of a bane for us.' What is the exact relationship between 'boon' and 'bane'?

options.text: Antonyms: 'boon' means a helpful benefit, whereas 'bane' means a cause of harm or ruin.
Synonyms: both words refer to technological destruction.
Homophones: words that sound identical but have unrelated origins.
Collocations: words that must always be used together as verbs.

questions.explanation: 'Boon' (a blessing or benefit) and 'bane' (a source of misery or ruin) are direct antonyms juxtaposed to show contrast.

questions.question: When the electricity supply failed during the storm, the online research team had to ______ internet access and rely on offline reference books.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'do without' means to manage or get along in the absence of something unavailable.

questions.question: Reorder the jumbled words into a syntactically correct sentence: 'lives / of / internet / reshaped / the / modern / human / aspect / has / virtually / every / .'

options.text: The internet has reshaped virtually every aspect of modern human lives.
Virtually every aspect of modern human lives internet has reshaped.
Has reshaped virtually every aspect of modern human lives the internet.
The internet virtually aspect has reshaped of modern human lives.

questions.explanation: Standard English word order requires: Subject ('The internet') + Present Perfect verb ('has reshaped') + Adverb ('virtually') + Direct Object phrase ('every aspect of modern human lives').
